method: For every frozen 2011-01 through 2022-12 month, verify the exact local PDF byte SHA-256 and size against its request or reuse receipt. Read PDF text once. Find exactly one page explicitly headed Exhibit 7 U.S. Exports of Goods by End-Use Category and Commodity with an exact Semiconductors row. Record source page, current-month and same-release previous-month printed dollar values, printed month change, and first-page release header. Preserve missing or ambiguous rows as exceptions; never fill from neighboring releases or today's revised API.
source_row_unit: millions of current U.S. dollars, seasonally adjusted within the original monthly release
acceptance: 144 unique month identities and 144 verified raw hashes; separately report number of unique Exhibit 7 row parses, numerical rows and release headers. Full row coverage only if all 144 parse unambiguously.
known_limit: PDF printed header and today's archived PDF bytes do not certify historically first-public availability. The 2012 commodity classification change requires a separate cross-boundary decision. This source audit cannot authorize a Stage1 factor, fit or 0bp account.
